footer.notice: Opus Populi is a civic-education tool for illustrative purposes. Its data comes from official public records (such as the California Secretary of State's CAL-ACCESS database and the U.S. Federal Election Commission), always with attribution. Those records are authoritative; the summaries this site generates are AI-produced, and the links it draws (including campaign-finance attributions) are automated best-effort and may be incomplete or inaccurate — not an allegation of wrongdoing. Verify against the official sources before relying on or republishing anything here.

promptRecord.title: Published prompt
promptRecord.invalid: That is not a prompt fingerprint. Fingerprints are 64 characters of 0–9 and a–f, as shown in a passage's “How this was made” receipt.
promptRecord.unavailable: We could not read the public prompt record just now, so this fingerprint has not been checked. That does not mean the prompt is unpublished — you can look it up yourself in
promptRecord.unpublished: This fingerprint is not in the public prompt record as checked just now, so the text it identifies cannot be checked here. A prompt published in the last hour may not appear yet. You can look it up yourself in
promptRecord.textHeading: The exact text the model was given
promptRecord.placeholders: The document being analysed is inserted where markers like {{marker}} appear.
promptRecord.verifyIntro: You don’t have to take our word for any of this. The file is named by the fingerprint of its own contents, so anyone can confirm it is unaltered:
promptRecord.verifyMatch: The fingerprint printed must equal the one above. If even one character of the file had changed, it would not.

readingNotice.title: How to read this site
readingNotice.sources: Everything here comes from official public records, and each page names its source. Those records are the authority; check them before you rely on or repeat anything.
readingNotice.ai: Summaries marked “AI-generated” were written by a model and may contain errors.
readingNotice.links: Links between people, money and measures are matched automatically. They may be wrong, and they are not an allegation of wrongdoing.
